senses.gloss:
छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, divided.
 E. छो to cut, affix क्त deriv. irr.

छित्ति f. (-त्तिः)
 1. Cutting, division.
 2. A plant, (Galedupa arborea:)
see करज.
 E. छिद् to cut, affix कर्त्तरि क्तिच्.

छित्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
 1. Roguish, fraudulent, knavish, a knave.
 2. Hos-
tile, inimical, a foe.
 3. Cutting or fit for cutting, (a weapon, &c.)
E. छिद् to cut, ष्वरप् Uṇādi affix, and त optionally substituted for the
radical final, otherwise छिद्वर.

छित्वा ind. Having cut or divided.
 E. छिद् to cut, क्त्वा aff.
